head: ṭrq (cf. tarqi būn bčiye-da = mṭarqi bu=ṭuro-da (e.g. a=ʕwone), то есть он лабильный в туройо)

examples.turoyo: Azzeyo, qṭile alfo w ḥammәšmo mәnne. Ann-alfo w ḥamməšmo ḥrene mahzamme, kul ḥa bdúkṯoda azzé. Mṭarqile, kul ḥa bdukṯoda azzeyo = L-OA mbarbzile (dispersed them) Aḥmad Aġa: 32
examples.note: Azzeyo, qṭile alfo w ḥammәšmo mәnne. Ann-alfo w ḥamməšmo ḥrene mahzamme, kul ḥa bdúkṯoda azzé. Mṭarqile, kul ḥa bdukṯoda azzeyo = L-OA mbarbzile (dispersed them) Aḥmad Aġa: 32

U=sawalayḏan kule lu=dewo mtarqile bu-ṭuro-da (Ilyas p.c.)

notes: II mṭaraqle/mṭaraq to disperse (tr.)/to disperse oneselves
